title: Migrate AgentChat to crate-jmap's split ChatBackend hook traits (pin >= 2f00d5d9)
description: crate-jmap phase 1 (7353ae03 split, 2f4ebe6b Delegate* traits; pin 2f00d5d9+) breaks AgentChat. One impl per hook trait: ChatStore (create_object, create_message, update_object, destroy_object, supports_type), ChatModeration (ban hooks, kick_chat_members), ChatRestrictions (may_update_chat, may_update_message), ChatSettings (limits, retains_edit_history, owner_user_id, maintains_unread_count forward), ChatResolvers (attachment_blob), empty ChatEvents. Delegate to self.inner: DelegateChatSpaces, DelegateSpacePolicy, DelegateChatAccessPolicy, DelegateChatMessageLifecycle. Import hook traits where hooks are called on concrete types (all re-exported at jmap_chat_server root). JmapBackend still hand-forwarded (phase 2 JMAP-fmi6). Start after blob-limits merges (both touch mimid-agent-jmap).
close_reason: AgentChat split over hook traits; crate-jmap pinned at b85dfc85
